opening: Before we begin, let us clear our minds of distractions and make room for prayer. We turn our attention to Jesus, with Mary. Sit comfortably. Breathe gently, without straining. Let us take four gentle, comfortable breaths together.
start: Let us pray together. In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.
closing: In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.
support: Thank you for praying with us. Subscribe to support the channel and help us create more prayers like this.
announce1: The first Sorrowful Mystery. The Agony in the Garden. The fruit of this mystery is faithfulness to the Father's will.
announce2: The second Sorrowful Mystery. The Scourging at the Pillar. The fruit of this mystery is purity of heart.
announce3: The third Sorrowful Mystery. The Crowning with Thorns. The fruit of this mystery is moral courage and humility.
announce4: The fourth Sorrowful Mystery. The Carrying of the Cross. The fruit of this mystery is patience and faithful endurance.
announce5: The fifth Sorrowful Mystery. The Crucifixion. The fruit of this mystery is self-giving love and repentance.
sorrowful_1-step-01:
Jesus prays in the garden with sorrow unto death. He asks that the cup pass, yet submits fully: "Nevertheless not as I will, but as thou wilt." He finds the disciples sleeping and calls them to watch and pray. He accepts the Passion in perfect trust.

In Gethsemane, Jesus embraces the Father's will in agony, teaching obedience under suffering.

Stay with this mystery as you pray.
sorrowful_5-step-01:
Jesus is crucified between two criminals. He is mocked, yet forgives and promises paradise to the repentant thief. Darkness falls; then Jesus cries out, "Father, into thy hands I commend my spirit." Then He dies. The centurion recognizes His innocence.

At Calvary, Jesus offers His life completely and opens mercy even at the hour of death.

Stay with this mystery as you pray.
sorrowful_2-step-05: Picture Jesus turning His heart to the Father in prayer.
sorrowful_2-step-08: Ask Christ for purity of heart. Picture His steadfast love for every person.
sorrowful_2-step-10: Picture Jesus remaining faithful to the Father, even when others are unkind.
sorrowful_2-step-11: Picture the love of Jesus reaching you in your own difficulties.
sorrowful_3-step-04: Picture Jesus, the humble King, answering cruelty with patient love.
sorrowful_4-step-03: Picture Jesus beginning the road to Calvary, trusting the Father.
sorrowful_4-step-05: The Stations of the Cross traditionally invite us to remember Jesus falling and rising again. Picture His patient courage on the road.
sorrowful_4-step-06: The Stations of the Cross traditionally invite us to remember Mary meeting Jesus. Picture their loving gaze along the road.
sorrowful_5-step-03: Picture Mary and the beloved disciple remaining near Jesus at the Cross.
apostles_creed: I believe in God, the Father almighty, Creator of heaven and earth, and in Jesus Christ, his only Son, our Lord, who was conceived by the Holy Spirit, born of the Virgin Mary, suffered under Pontius Pilate, was crucified, died and was buried; he descended into hell; on the third day he rose again from the dead; he ascended into heaven, and is seated at the right hand of God the Father almighty; from there he will come to judge the living and the dead. I believe in the Holy Spirit, the holy catholic Church, the communion of saints, the forgiveness of sins, the resurrection of the body, and life everlasting. Amen.
fatima: O my Jesus, forgive us our sins, save us from the fires of hell; lead all souls to Heaven, especially those who have most need of your mercy.
rosary_concluding_prayer: O God, whose Only Begotten Son, by his life, Death, and Resurrection, has purchased for us the rewards of eternal life, grant, we beseech thee, that while meditating on these mysteries of the most holy Rosary of the Blessed Virgin Mary, we may imitate what they contain and obtain what they promise, through the same Christ our Lord. Amen.
dialogue_v: Pray for us, O holy Mother of God.
dialogue_r: That we may be made worthy of the promises of Christ.
hail_holy_queen: Hail, Holy Queen, Mother of mercy, our life, our sweetness, and our hope. To thee do we cry, poor banished children of Eve. To thee do we send up our sighs, mourning and weeping in this valley of tears. Turn then, most gracious advocate, thine eyes of mercy toward us, and after this our exile show unto us the blessed fruit of thy womb, Jesus. O clement, O loving, O sweet Virgin Mary.
